name: Count Dardante's Island
title: Count Dardante's Island
summary: Count Dardante's island stronghold, just off the Isle of Ruin at 91.3N 38.4W. A rock about 110 m across rises 84 m sheer out of the deep sea. It is crowned by a walled Viamontian villa (a 16 m mansion with columns, red lion banners and a candelabrum), ringed by twelve 26 m gold-roofed stone towers and wall towers.

shots.standingOrder: Skim west 3 m over the open sea straight at Count Dardante's island fortress with the late-morning sun behind, the east towers rising over the 84 m cliff; stop 128 m short of the cliff foot.
shots.notes: Signature water shot. A 3 m skim west over the open deep sea straight at the island, with the late-morning sun behind. The east towers rise over the 84 m cliff, and the climb in the lens tilt (+10 deg) keeps them in frame. The skim ends 128 m short of the cliff foot, 100 % over water. shots.standingOrder: Climb counter-clockwise from south-south-east to south-east round the island, 110 to 125 m out and 38 to 58 m above its plateau, the villa and its gold-roofed towers turning against the open sea; stay 33 m from every tower.
shots.notes: Helix. The camera climbs 25 deg counter-clockwise, 110-125 m out and 38-58 m above the plateau, over the sea and ice ring south-east of the island. The walled villa and its twelve gold-roofed towers turn against the open sea. A tower roof clips the line of sight once in the window (1/27).
